decisions.source_name: Phragmites australis subsp. americanus Saltonst., P.M.Peterson & Soreng
decisions.reason: POWO accepts North American subspecies at subspecies rank; original description supported by morphological and genetic data.

decisions.reason: POWO lists 2023 variety-rank combination as homotypic synonym of accepted subspecies.

decisions.source_name: Proposed blanket classification of every Phragmites australis as introduced/invasive or native
decisions.reason: Species includes native North American, introduced Eurasian and Gulf Coast lineages; a species-level label cannot establish specimen lineage.

decisions.source_name: Proposed separate accepted species card Phragmites americanus under POWO/WCVP
decisions.reason: POWO treats P. americanus as synonym of P. australis subsp. americanus. Do not install or duplicate a separately accepted species concept.

decisions.source_name: Four existing Phragmites australis learner photographs and source-labelled Phragmites americanus comparison
decisions.reason: Photographic source names and gross features do not establish individual subspecies, local origin, or genotype. Preserve existing provisional lineage cautions.

decisions.source_name: Potential inter-lineage hybrid ancestry of individual Phragmites vouchers/photos
decisions.reason: Literature discusses hybridization and complex Gulf Coast genetic histories, but no learner specimen has parentage established by molecular evidence.

decisions.source_name: North American origin/cryptogenic status of P. australis subsp. berlandieri
decisions.reason: POWO distribution treats Gulf Coast subspecies as native to Texas; primary North American literature describes uncertain or cryptogenic origin and complex hybrid ancestry. Taxonomy acceptance is PASS, local origin inference unresolved; no county nativity audit.

decisions.source_name: Historical records identified only as Phragmites australis / Phragmites communis without voucher lineage data
decisions.reason: Historical species-level names or synonym mappings cannot retrospectively establish native/introduced/Gulf Coast subspecies of a particular specimen.

limitations: The species-level canonical card cannot identify native vs introduced vs Gulf Coast lineage of any photograph.
